question: Using the sales data, what is the median value of total sales made in countries where the number of customers is greater than 4?
sql:
WITH qualifying_countries AS (
    SELECT Country FROM customers GROUP BY Country HAVING COUNT(*) > 4
),
sales_data AS (
    SELECT i.Total 
    FROM invoices i
    JOIN customers c ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId
    WHERE c.Country IN (SELECT Country FROM qualifying_countries)
)
SELECT COUNT(*) as row_count, MEDIAN(Total) as median_value FROM sales_data
